subtitle: BOUTIQUE DIGITAL EFFECTS
intro: AMATISTA is a boutique line of digital effects built with an obsession for detail, minimalist aesthetics, and a hardware-inspired sonic feel. Precision tools for modern guitars, low tunings, and contemporary sounds.
bajoSubtitle: Saturation and character for deep frequencies.
collabsSubtitle: Plugins built together with artists and independent makers.
carbonadoDesc: CARBONADO is a minimalist boost inspired by modern metal and djent. Designed for low-tuned guitars, it tightens the low end, hardens the attack, and enhances definition without changing the core character of the amplifier. Ideal for tightening high-gain tones, improving palm mutes, and keeping complex riffs clear and focused.
impulsoPrimarioDesc: Primary Impulse is AMATISTA’s gain ecosystem. Each pedal has a clear role. They’re not meant to compete, but to stack into one coherent architecture
onixDesc: ÓNIX is a controlled-grain overdrive with a dynamic response. It adds body, edge, and cohesion, working both as a subtle push or as a primary drive for articulate riffs and defined leads.
amatistaDesc: AMATISTA is a modern, structured distortion focused on tension, clarity, and presence. It delivers anything from tight, controlled saturation to dense walls of distortion without losing definition.
obsidianaDesc: OBSIDIANA transforms raw distortion into a solid mass of sound. Its fuzz is dense, compressed, and expansive, capable of filling every space without losing control. From gritty textures to overwhelming saturation, it allows you to shape chaos with intention, balancing weight, edge, and clarity. Designed to integrate naturally with other gain pedals, OBSIDIANA becomes the foundation of massive, immersive, and deeply expressive tones.
